title: Nf Round4 Modular Charpoly
objective: Implement exact modular/CRT characteristic polynomials for modified Round Four residue-beta stages, preserving fail-closed reconstruction evidence and completing vector 010 if sufficient

runs.command: node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern=deep primary Round-4 stages|vector 010 fails closed|bounded modular characteristic reconstruction test/number-field-round4.cjs

handoff.summary: Commits bf2f475d and e5e28b3c implement exact residue-beta modular/CRT characteristic polynomials with coefficient-bound and cyclic-Krylov certificates, plus an exact Hadamard-cost gate. Frozen #2510 and vector008 stay on direct arithmetic at bounds 246/955 and run in 405ms/15.74s; vector010 selects CRT at bound 5970, reconstructs with 122 primes and a cyclic certificate, then reaches the next fail-closed boundary.
risks: Unrestricted vector010 still exceeds 180 seconds after the proved residue-beta improvement because the next uncached residue-root-error rational characteristic polynomial has 2647 coordinate bits and denominator-bit 12.
The architecture package graph needs an integration-lane arithmetic bootstrap budget update: the lane measured 622434 bytes against the previous 622000-byte limit.
next_steps: Extend the same exact cleared-matrix reconstruction and rational-denominator certification to the residue-root-error characteristic stage without weakening fail-closed behavior.
Rerun unrestricted vector010 under the existing 180-second bound and the broad native platform tier after integration.
